intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Buford, with the prices out in the open
paragraphs: Buford Renovations offers kitchen remodeling in Buford for homeowners who want one person to answer for the whole job. That person is Oscar Tamez, owner and lead contractor, with 20+ years in residential construction and hundreds of kitchen and bathroom remodels managed across Gwinnett, Hall and Forsyth counties.

Custom cabinetry is the craft the company was founded on, so cabinets get planned first: built to the ceiling, fitted around awkward corners and finished with soft-close hardware and pull-outs. Oscar also publishes 2026 cost guides for Buford and nearby towns, so you can see real local price ranges before the free in-home visit.

services.h2: What Oscar's crews build, from kitchens to covered decks

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Layout changes, custom or semi-custom cabinets, quartz, granite or butcher block counters, full-height backsplashes, islands with seating and layered lighting. Open-concept projects include the structural engineering, permits and beam work. Most full kitchens take 4 to 8 weeks once materials are on hand.

image.alt: Open kitchen with white flat-panel cabinets, a fluted wood range hood, a long curved wood island with a stone top and wide-plank oak floors by Buford Renovations

items.name: Bathroom remodeling and walk-in showers
items.blurb: The most requested job is swapping an unused tub for a custom tile walk-in shower with frameless glass, a bench and a niche. The team also builds primary suites with freestanding tubs and heated floors, compact hall baths and curbless aging-in-place showers.

items.name: Custom carpentry and built-ins

image.alt: Two-level pressure-treated wood deck with stairs and a covered lower patio on the back of a home, Double Deck Retreat by Buford Renovations

about.h2: Meet Oscar Tamez, owner and lead contractor
about.text: Oscar Tamez owns Buford Renovations LLC and runs its jobs as lead contractor. He brings 20+ years of hands-on residential construction experience and has personally managed hundreds of kitchen and bathroom remodels across Gwinnett, Hall and Forsyth counties. The company is not a franchise and does not hand everything off to subcontractors, and Oscar stays personally involved in every project. Google lists the business as Latino-owned. Oscar writes the company's cost guides himself, explaining in plain numbers what drives a budget, from cabinets at 30 to 40 percent of a kitchen to the tile and shower package in a bath.

image.alt: Bright primary bathroom with a freestanding tub, a glass walk-in shower and a long white double vanity by Buford Renovations

process.h2: How a Buford Renovations remodel runs

steps.title: Free in-home consultation
steps.text: The team visits your home to measure the space, hear what you want and talk honestly about scope and budget.

steps.title: Fixed written estimate
steps.text: You receive a detailed, fixed written estimate, usually within 48 hours of the visit, with no obligation to go ahead.

steps.title: Design and selections
steps.text: Layout, cabinetry, counters, tile, vanity, glass, fixtures and lighting are chosen with you before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Permits and build
steps.text: The crew pulls permits, works to a written schedule, contains the work zone, protects floors and nearby rooms, and cleans up daily.

steps.title: Walkthrough and punch list
steps.text: The job closes with a final walkthrough and a punch list, so the last details are finished before the crew leaves.

service_area.h2: Serving Buford, Sugar Hill and nine nearby towns
service_area.text: Buford Renovations works from 694 Buford Hwy in Sugar Hill. The team remodels kitchens and baths in Buford, Sugar Hill, Suwanee, Duluth and Dacula in Gwinnett County, in Gainesville, Oakwood and Flowery Branch in Hall County, in Cumming in Forsyth County, and in Braselton and Dawsonville. Gainesville is about 20 minutes up I-985. Live outside these towns? Call (404) 376-5391 anyway, since the crew often travels farther for the right project.

faq.h2: Buford remodeling questions, answered with real numbers

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Buford?
items.a: Oscar's 2026 Buford guide lists four levels: a basic refresh at $10,000 to $20,000, a mid-range remodel at $25,000 to $45,000, a high-end renovation at $50,000 to $80,000 or more, and a gut and rebuild at $75,000 to $120,000 or more. Most full remodels of a standard 10 by 12 foot kitchen land between $30,000 and $50,000.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel or walk-in shower cost?
items.a: The 2026 Buford bathroom guide puts a cosmetic refresh at $3,500 to $8,500, a mid-range full renovation at $15,000 to $28,000 and a high-end primary suite at $30,000 to $55,000 or more. Tub-to-shower conversions with custom tile and frameless glass usually run $8,000 to $15,000 installed. Oscar suggests setting aside 10 to 15 percent for surprises behind the walls.

items.q: How long will my kitchen or bathroom take?
items.a: Most full kitchen remodels take 4 to 8 weeks once materials are on hand. Most full bathrooms take 3 to 5 weeks from demolition to final walkthrough, and shower conversions are often faster. You get a written schedule before work starts. January through March is usually the slower season, which often means you can get on the calendar sooner.

items.q: Do you handle permits in Buford, Sugar Hill and Gwinnett County?
items.a: Yes. As a licensed Georgia general contractor, Buford Renovations pulls and manages permits and inspections through the City of Buford, the City of Sugar Hill, Gwinnett County, Hall County or whichever office covers your address, including structural permits for wall removals. In Gwinnett, plan on 1 to 3 weeks for approval when plumbing is being moved.

items.q: Can we live at home during the remodel?
items.a: Almost all clients do. The crew contains the work zone, protects floors and nearby rooms and leaves the site clean every day. If your home has a second bathroom, daily life goes on around the job. One Google reviewer who had a full bathroom redone said the team was respectful of the rest of the house.

final_cta.text: Call for a free in-home consultation, or send the short form and the team will reply within one business day.
